blocks.text: 总体来看，公司的财务状况出奇地好。2025年至2026年初，营收大幅飙升，使公司在第二季度首次实现营业利润。截至6月底，Anthropic的现金储备超过了除谷歌和伯克希尔·哈撒韦之外的所有非银行企业。

inlines.text: 总体来看，公司的财务状况出奇地好。2025年至2026年初，营收大幅飙升，使公司在第二季度首次实现营业利润。截至6月底，Anthropic的现金储备超过了除谷歌和伯克希尔·哈撒韦之外的所有非银行企业。

blocks.text: 不过，未来几年对这家AI巨头来说可能充满挑战。出于对持续增长的预期，Anthropic已承诺向亚马逊、谷歌、SpaceXAI、博通等公司投入数千亿美元用于算力。要收回这些支出，Anthropic的年营收需要增长到数千亿美元。

inlines.text: 不过，未来几年对这家AI巨头来说可能充满挑战。出于对持续增长的预期，Anthropic已承诺向亚马逊、谷歌、SpaceXAI、博通等公司投入数千亿美元用于算力。要收回这些支出，Anthropic的年营收需要增长到数千亿美元。

blocks.text: Anthropic尚未正式公布第三季度营收，但媒体报道显示其营收增速有所放缓。营收从2026年第一季度的47亿美元跃升至第二季度的116亿美元，第三季度为168亿美元。按常规企业标准衡量，这仍是惊人的增长，但增速已低于上一季度。

blocks.text: 因此，Anthropic财务状况最大的悬念在于：第三季度营收为何没有增长得更快——以及这对未来意味着什么。或许Anthropic的营收将在未来一年继续指数级增长，那样的话，公司轻松就能支付其算力承诺。

blocks.text: 但也可能Claude Code和Anthropic其他产品的需求正接近饱和。若果真如此，第四季度及以后的营收增速可能进一步放缓，届时公司可能难以兑现已经做出的数千亿美元支出承诺。

blocks.text: Back in June, Anthropic filed a confidential draft of its S-1 form with the Securities and Exchange Commission — a crucial step toward offering stock to the general public. On Monday, Anthropic announced that it had filed a public version of the same document. I read it cover to cover, and I learned a lot about the company’s finances — at least through June 30 of this year.

blocks.text: Overall, the company’s financial position is surprisingly good. Revenue soared between 2025 and early 2026, allowing the company to report its first-ever operating profit in the second quarter. At the end of June, Anthropic had more cash reserves than all but two non-bank companies: Google and Berkshire Hathaway.

blocks.text: However, the next couple of years could be challenging for the AI giant. Anticipating continued growth, Anthropic has committed to spend hundreds of billions of dollars on compute from Amazon, Google, SpaceXAI, Broadcom, and other companies. To recoup that spending, Anthropic needs its annual revenue to grow to hundreds of billions of dollars as well.

blocks.text: Anthropic hasn’t officially reported its third quarter revenue, but media reports suggest a modest slowdown in revenue growth. Revenue surged from $4.7 billion in the first quarter of 2026 to $11.6 billion in the second quarter. Third quarter revenue was $16.8 billion. That’s still incredible growth by normal corporate standards, but it’s a slower pace of growth than in the previous quarter.

blocks.text: So the biggest open question about Anthropic’s finances is why revenue didn’t grow faster in the third quarter — and what that says about the future. Maybe Anthropic’s revenue will continue growing exponentially over the coming year. In that case, the company will easily be able to pay for its compute commitments.

blocks.text: But it’s also possible that demand for Claude Code and Anthropic’s other products is nearing saturation. In that case, revenue might grow even more slowly in the fourth quarter and beyond. Then the company could struggle to make good on the hundreds of billions of dollars in spending commitments it has already made.
